title: Q-SPEC-24-billing-watchdog-on-tick: the platform's tick reads Actions billing usage and sets the pause itself (US-24-R21 to R24, R26)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:git grep -q settings/billing/usage -- seed/worker/src
**Status:** closed

specs/US-SPEC-24-github-substrate-and-cost-control.md section 10.1 lists as PLANNED on the platform: the pause of non-essential workflows is a committed value in actions-budget.json that nothing derives from usage. The reader, the 50, 80 and 100 percent decisions, the monthly ledger row and the spending-limit probe are built and tested in workers/core/ghcost and workers/tools/actions_budget.py, and are not wired into the tick the platform runs (seed/worker/src/index.js).

Vendor core/ghcost into the kit as an opt-in loop inside beat(), read usage through the GitHub App token the tick already holds, write one ledger row per month and repository, open the decision cards with their default in effect, and let the loop propose the pause as a change the lane merges (a metered repository only; a public one is exempt, US-24-R59). Record one real billing response as the test fixture (US-24-R22). Then move the row in section 10.1 to BUILT.

**Prediction:** tick_reads_billing_usage >= 1 within 336 h (the number of lines the done check finds; 0 today)
**Out of scope:** raising any budget or spending limit (identity-bound, US-24-R20), or pausing an essential workflow.

size: M

**Closing probe:** cmd:git grep -q settings/billing/usage -- seed/worker/src (exit 0): the kit reads the billing endpoint. Its tests pass in `cd seed/worker && node test/run.mjs`.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T14:19:27Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
